obligations.note: ApplicantValidator.checkIncome now logs the raw annual_income value on the validation error path (`log.warn("Annual income format rejected on " + caseRef + ": " + value)`), replacing Mask.npi. Annual income is NPI (ENC-1 and mortgage.npi_fields), and LOG-1 forbids unmasked NPI in any log entry, including error paths. The passing LoggingControlTest is sample coverage and does not cover this call site.

The change names ticket CHG-26593, which change manager Erik Brandt approved on 2026-10-04 before review, and its component mortgage.cases matches ApplicantValidator.java in controls/mortgage/components.json.
Declan Farrell, a baseline-mortgage change_approver and not the author Tomas Ortega, approved a code_review of commit 599a8a8ec423e9ba2d6334cb38b9aaedc4fe44f1.
The change is a single commit, and the code_review approval names that same head commit.

records/ci/run.json shows the baseline-mortgage suite succeeding on the head commit, and the JUnit report has 124 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, and 0 skipped, including the registered mortgage control tests.
The only changed file, ApplicantValidator.java, is component mortgage.cases with security_sensitive false, so a security_review approval is not required.
The diff does not touch a protected path (controls data, control tests, or CI), so a control_owner approval is not required.
Ticket CHG-26593 is type standard and the change record sets emergency to false, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The unmasked income log is a LOG-1 deviation. EXC-0167 is approved and unexpired, but it is scoped to component mortgage.logging and masked last-4 bank-account output from the legacy import job, so it does not authorize this mortgage.cases change.
The acceptance ledger covers payments payments, audit, and routes, and mortgage Approvals, Underwriting, and Policy. ApplicantValidator is outside those covers, so that evidence has not lapsed.

summary: The change replaces a masked income warning with a log line that writes the raw annual_income value on a validation error path. Income is nonpublic personal information, so LOG-1 is violated, and exception EXC-0167 does not cover this component or this behavior. Ticket, independent approval, commit coverage, CI on the head commit, and the inapplicable security, control-owner, and emergency requirements are in order, but those process records cannot excuse the logging breach. The change is rejected.
